  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Convert an uploaded image to a video using ComfyUI workflow.

### Temporary TLS workaround (Staging/Production)
If you see `ERR_CERT_COMMON_NAME_INVALID` on **Staging** / **Production**, it's a temporary certificate hostname mismatch.

- **curl**: add `--insecure` (or `-k`)
- **Postman**: disable SSL certificate verification
- **Browser calls**: generally cannot bypass TLS verification; wait for the certificate fix

### Example (Development)
```bash
curl --location 'https://api-mico-gen-ai.dev-craft.mico.one/aivision/imageToVideo' \
  --header 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY' \
  --form 'imageFile=@/path/to/image.jpg' \
  --form-string 'prompt=Describe the motion you want in the video' \
  --form 'videoLength=3'
```

### Example (Staging)
```bash
curl -k --location 'https://mico.gen.ai.stg-craft.mico.one/aivision/imageToVideo' \
  --header 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY' \
  --form 'imageFile=@/path/to/image.jpg' \
  --form-string 'prompt=Describe the motion you want in the video' \
  --form 'videoLength=3'
```
